name: Scientific Realism
tagline: Grades films and clips 0-10 on their science, here and inside the story's own frame.
description: Hand it a film, a series or a short clip and you get a science mark from 0 to 10 with a short sourced writeup behind it. Once a story leaves Earth behind, the mark splits in two: one grade for how the science stands up against real physics, another for how faithfully it keeps to the rulebook the story wrote for itself.
author: Wardonis
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
